file_ref: CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased, upgrade note, 'Scripts and hooks that read the exit')
summary: [standards] The upgrade note's command sentence for the 21 codes that moved to exit 2 names nine commands (subject move, gate promote, task done, evidence add, brief approve, strategy promote, ingest plans, dashboard, context-pack add) and misses the commands of three pure-moved codes: DISPATCH_END_IN_PROGRESS (dispatch begin and dispatch end, now DISPATCH_RUN_UNAVAILABLE), DIVERGENCE_REFUSED (divergence defer and resolve, now DIVERGENCE_INVALID) and LEARN_EVALUATION_REJECTED (strategy approval-payload, now STRATEGY_EVALUATION_INVALID). The first list carries every code, so a branch on the code is covered; a script that keys on the command and its exit 1 is not told. atip.codestable.12 checks a fixed list of nine commands, so it cannot catch the omission. Add the three, or say the list of codes is the truth and the commands are examples.
